profile.headline: Web Developer at Allegheny County
profile.summary: Hello I am an Web Developer from Toledo Ohio. Moved to Pittsburgh in 2011 to pursue a degree in Web Design and Interactive media. I currently hold a position of Web Developer / Webmaster for Allegheny County in the Department of Information Technology. I also work on .NET applications and work with CMS systems like Ektron and EPIserver.

positions.title: Web Developer / Web Application Developer
positions.description:
- Handle the day to day request for updating the website using EKTRON CMS system
- Work with application developers to create .Net Web Applications
- Give Design tips and mock ups to keep the website looking fresh
- Train new CMS users
- Implement any development changes to main site.(Home page redesigns, new templates and new additions to website.)

positions.title: The Gravity MetaPhysical Shop
positions.description: This was a second installment of That Calee Sun Website. she owns two businesses and I created this Wix website for her.

positions.title: ThatCaleeSun
positions.description: Helped a local business woman get her Wix Website up and running. Also redesigned and redeveloped her current website.

positions.title: Hr Screening
positions.description:
- Create  mock-up designs for page layout
- Created Icons to use on site
- Created banner images
- Formatted interior pages
- Styled the website
- Update and Manage content.

positions.title: Contractor / Content Specialist
positions.description:
- Provided support with redesign ideas as far as page layouts and what content should go where.
- Transferred and refreshed all content from the old Port Authority site into the new site. I removed any old or irrelevant information.(PDFS, images and other Assets)
- Used EPIServer to Create and link all content for the website. Including creating all Icons throughout the site.

projects.title: Allegheny County Website Re-Design
projects.description: Fresh Revamp of the old Allegheny County website. Includes many new feature and mobile friendly.

projects.title: New World Live
projects.description: Music and news page for three artist stationed in Pittsburgh Pennsylvania.
